primary.name: Daily Global News Digest
guidance: Publish a concise ranked list every day, even when the global news cycle is quiet.
Focus on events with cross-border consequences, policy impact, human impact, or clear follow-up value.
Avoid routine political noise, opinion-only coverage, celebrity news, local crime without global relevance, and stories already covered without material updates.

audience: Dünyadaki yüksek etkili gelişmeleri tek Türkçe özetle görmek isteyen power user'lar
Jeopolitik, diplomasi, seçimler, afetler, sağlık, enerji, regülasyon ve büyük politika kararlarını takip eden okurlar
Haber akışını gündem kalabalığı değil, doğrulanmış global etki sıralaması olarak tüketmek isteyen kişiler

rankBy: cross-border geopolitical, diplomatic, economic, humanitarian, public-health, security, climate, or legal impact
primary-source confirmation from governments, courts, international organizations, regulators, emergency agencies, or official statements
breadth of affected people, countries, markets, institutions, or supply chains
newness and materiality versus already covered background
clear next-step value: deadline, vote, summit, court ruling, sanctions, ceasefire, evacuation, aid, or policy implementation
relevance to Turkish readers without turning the digest into domestic politics coverage
rejectIf: source link is missing or circular
claim is only social-media speculation, pundit commentary, or a single unverified rumor
story is routine domestic politics with no wider global effect
story is celebrity, crime, lifestyle, sports, or culture news without major international relevance
same story was already covered in recent automation memory without a material update
headline is sensational but verified consequences are unclear
